$comment: THE closed binding set of the report schema (Spec 126 11a.1; Spec 128 Rule 20; Spec 135 FE-18, FE-21, FE-23, FE-27). Every displayed field's `source` is `<kind>:<member>` with <kind> a key of `sources` below; any other kind fails RS-1. A member must resolve through its source's resolver; a source whose contract file has not landed (`file: null`) has no member yet (the ad contract landed with MF-20), so a field naming it fails until the contract lands. PROTECTED: adding a source or a member needs a Spec 135 register row and a panel (MB-67 owner sign-off on the protected-paths edit). Read by scripts/analysis/report-schema.mjs and src/tests/surfaces/report-binding.logic.test.ts.

catalogue.member: a catalogue row id; the payload key is the row id and the unit agrees with the row's `unit`

content.member: a key of the label, help-text and legal-copy registry (dotted path)

user_input.member: an id in the input contract (the form archetype)

ad_slot.member: an id in the ad contract (Spec 126 11a.10)

external_embed.member: a declared external embed: map tiles, payment checkout, analytics

contract.member: <contract_id>.<field>: a field of a declared CONTRACT descriptor's response projection (its inputs.field_whitelist); MF-37. Refused for REPORT fields (RS-1) until a ruling widens it; SURFACE goldens resolve it in SV-SBIND

parcels.member: a column of the parcels table, in the migrations, on the Spec 100 section 3.2 consumer whitelist
